Compute budget instruction parsing, validation, and default compute unit setup for transactions.

# Purpose
This file implements the `ComputeBudget` program handling used by the transaction executor. It scans transaction instructions, identifies instructions that belong to the `fd_solana_compute_budget_program_id` program, decodes their data, and stores the requested compute budget settings in `fd_exec_txn_ctx_t::compute_budget_details`. It also counts builtin and non-builtin instructions so the executor can derive the default compute unit limit when the transaction does not set one. The code rejects invalid instruction data and duplicate compute budget instructions, and it validates requested heap size and loaded account data size limits against the runtime limits.

The file also contains the final sanitizing step for compute budget values before execution. The [`fd_sanitize_compute_unit_limits`](<#fd_sanitize_compute_unit_limits>) function applies the default compute unit limit, clamps limits to the maximum allowed values, sets the compute meter, and validates optional heap and account data size requests. The [`fd_compute_budget_program_execute`](<#fd_compute_budget_program_execute>) function is the program entry point used during execution, and it updates the compute unit counter by `DEFAULT_COMPUTE_UNITS` before returning success.
